fields.statement: Verifier at a67915229a: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(daemon-settings-scope|daemon-settings|usage-settings|describe-golden|run-ship-change|ship-deploy-settings|stage-autonomy) all PASS. daemon-settings-scope.txtar sets rhiza.daemon.maxRuns (found in $WORK/rhiza.toml, absent from git config) and rhiza.autonomy.ship (found in project a's git config), sees both in daemon settings with (rhiza.toml, machine)/(git config, project) and in --json with scope and source, sees rhiza.daemon.trimGoCache with machine scope, and fails a project key set at the root without --project; with two projects each with its own rhiza.eventCommand, one daemon --once poll writes A's two moves only to out-a and B's only to out-b. By hand with a scratch build and root: daemon set rhiza.autonomy.ship owner at the root exits 2 naming --project; daemon settings --project a --json lists trimGoCache scope machine. internal/rootcfg tests pass; internal/api TestDaemon*, TestShipDeploy*, TestStatusHook*, daemon_projects_test and usage_hold_test (27 tests) pass. The full internal/api package timed out on this loaded host (load 8 on 4 cores) in the read-path budget tests (TestReadBudget, TestInboxGateQuestionsBudget), which this diff does not touch; CI runs those. Diff read: settingDefs gain a project flag, machine keys read/write rhiza.toml [daemon] via rootcfg.SetDaemon, project keys git config via scopeCtx/projectCtx, hooks resolved per project in daemon_projects.go.
